notes: ร้าน (ráan) means shop or store, and อาหาร (aa-hǎan) means food. Combined, they form the standard word for restaurant.
Do not confuse this with a street food stall, which is often called a ร้านข้างทาง (ráan khâang thaang) or simply referred to by the specific dish it sells.
